text: 中国央行公开市场开展4633亿元7天期逆回购操作，操作利率1.40%，持平上次。开展1000亿元14天期逆回购操作。今日6040亿元逆回购到期。中国央行公开市场本周净投放8268亿元。
text_en: The People's Bank of China conducted 463.3 billion yuan of 7-day reverse repurchase operations in the open market, with an operation rate of 1.40%, unchanged from the previous time. It conducted 100 billion yuan of 14-day reverse repurchase operations. Today, 604 billion yuan of reverse repurchase agreements mature. The PBOC posted a net injection of 826.8 billion yuan in the open market this week.
